model_claims.text: With `reindent=True`, a date scalar with an explicit alias splits the SELECT projection list.
model_claims.source_quote: With `reindent=True`, a date scalar with an explicit alias splits the SELECT projection list.

model_claims.text: For example, `SELECT 'value 1' AS VALUE_1, CURRENT_DATE AS CREATED_AT, 'testing' AS VALUE_2, 'testing2' AS VALUE_3 FROM TABLE_1` indents the last two columns by 23 spaces instead of 7.
